derived_from.section: Work package W4 — Immutable outcome and feedback ledger
derived_from.note: Refinement of the approved plan section into machine-readable criteria. No product scope is added, removed, or reinterpreted; every criterion traces to a plan line.

commit: feat(optimizer): add immutable outcomes and append-only feedback
campaign_invariants_in_force: additive schema only; no destructive migration and no production backfill
no production DB writes; disposable/test DBs only
SQLite and Postgres parity for every added column
strict TDD: one failing test, run it, implement only enough to pass, rerun

criteria.plan_line: exactly one mutable-finalized outcome row per root run, guarded by a unique root session ID
criteria.text: A root run has EXACTLY one outcome row. Uniqueness is enforced by the schema (a table-level UNIQUE on root session id, which is also the form the dual-DB parity parser can read), not only by service logic, so a concurrent second finalizer is refused by the database itself.

criteria.plan_line: append-only feedback events with source and confidence
criteria.text: Feedback rows are insert-only: no update or delete path exists in the repository, and a contradictory later verdict is retained alongside the earlier one. Every row carries an explicit `source` and `confidence`; W6 weights evidence by exactly those two fields, so a row without them is unusable downstream.

criteria.plan_line: exact links to session/root session, scheduled occurrence, proposal/experiment variant, profile/config revision, and attribution JSON
criteria.text: An outcome row carries session id, root session id, scheduled occurrence, proposal/experiment variant, the profile/config revision in force, and an attribution JSON blob.

criteria.plan_line: separate objective, explicit-user, and inferred evidence fields
criteria.text: Objective evidence, explicit user verdict, and inferred verdict occupy distinct fields. Reading one can never be mistaken for another.

criteria.plan_line: repository supports idempotent finalization and append-only feedback insertion; explicit feedback is never overwritten by inferred feedback
criteria.text: Finalizing the same root run twice is idempotent and yields the same row. An inferred verdict arriving after an explicit user verdict does not replace it; the explicit verdict remains the authoritative field.

criteria.plan_line: deterministic finalizer maps terminal status plus objective artifact/error/approval evidence to success | partial | failure | inconclusive
criteria.text: The finalizer is a pure deterministic function of terminal status and objective evidence. Proven behaviourally: the same input yields an identical outcome across repeated runs, and a full input->output fixture matrix pins every mapping. Absent or contradictory evidence yields `inconclusive`, never a guessed `success`.

criteria.plan_line: feedback API accepts success | partial | failure plus optional reason and actor; validates ownership/auth using existing route conventions
criteria.text: The route accepts exactly `success | partial | failure`, rejects anything else, and scopes ownership concretely — the ownerUserId / req.mobileDevice pattern used by run_quality_routes.ts:30-32 — rather than relying on `requireAuth`, which is a no-op under AGENT_LOCAL=true where this route actually runs. It sits behind the same registration gate as its sibling agent routes.

criteria.plan_line: terminal hooks create/finalize one ledger record without blocking the user turn. Duplicate terminal events remain idempotent.
criteria.text: The terminal hook is fire-and-forget with respect to the user turn and never throws into it. Duplicate terminal events for the same root run produce one row.

criteria.plan_line: Record exact invoked tool/skill revisions only when attributable; store unknown explicitly rather than inventing attribution.
criteria.text: Attribution records exact revisions when they are known, and an explicit unknown marker when they are not. A missing revision is never silently defaulted to a plausible value.

criteria.plan_line: Ensure prompts, tool arguments/outputs, credentials, and secret-like values are not copied into the ledger.
criteria.text: No prompt text, tool argument, tool output, credential, or secret-like value is written to the ledger tables. A test asserts this over a fixture containing all of those.

criteria.plan_line: Goal item 5: Add an immutable run-outcome and feedback ledger
criteria.text: A finalized outcome row cannot be mutated through the repository. There is no update path that can alter a finalized row's verdict or evidence fields.

criteria.plan_line: W4 acceptance: One terminal outcome per root run
criteria.text: A delegated child session's terminal event resolves to its ROOT run and produces no second outcome row. Proven with a parent/child session tree, not with a single flat session.

criteria.plan_line: Campaign invariant: SQLite and Postgres parity for every added column
criteria.text: Every new table and column exists in both engines and is visible to the dual-DB drift guard: the new tables are added to skill_schema_parity.test.ts's TABLES list, each Postgres table is its own pool.query template literal with indexes in separate calls, and no ALTER spans multiple lines (the parser cannot see those).

acceptance_gates: One terminal outcome per root run.
Explicit user verdict cannot be replaced by inference.
Exact revisions are attributed when known and marked unknown otherwise.
No raw prompts/tool payloads/secrets enter the new tables.
explicitly_out_of_scope: Desktop feedback controls beyond the API contract (plan: Deferred by design).
Any consumption of the ledger by an experiment gate — that is W6.

plan_interpretations.ambiguity: W4 step 2 says 'exactly one mutable-finalized outcome row per root run' in a package titled 'Immutable outcome and feedback ledger'.
plan_interpretations.reconciled_as: Mutable until finalized, immutable after. Reconciled from the package title and Goal item 5 ('Add an immutable run-outcome and feedback ledger'). Encoded as W4-c11.

plan_interpretations.ambiguity: No general root-session concept exists in the schema; root_session_id lives only on agent_scheduled_task_runs, and general trees are walked via agent_sessions.parent_session_id.
plan_interpretations.reconciled_as: The hook must resolve a delegated child's terminal event to its root before writing. Encoded as W4-c12 so 'one outcome per root run' is behaviourally provable rather than satisfied by a child-id unique constraint.
plan_interpretations.authority: plan W4 acceptance 'One terminal outcome per root run'

hazards: installRevisionInvariants puts an AFTER UPDATE auto-bump trigger on agent_configs and agent_org_proposals. Ledger state must NOT live on those tables; agent_profile_projections is the precedent — its own table, for exactly this reason.
skill_schema_parity.test.ts parses DDL by regex: it only sees single-line ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN and CREATE TABLE bodies whose closing paren is immediately followed by a backtick.
requireAuth is a no-op under AGENT_LOCAL=true, which is how the embedded desktop server runs — see W4-c7.
